label: Latest departure date
summary: The last date by which the character has to leave to join the activity shown in the activity list's join detail.
details: The game compares it with the current date to show or hide parts of the join panel, and also turns it into a time-left text in the line 'You have to leave within ...'. The exact meaning of the date rests on that use.

label: This join view
summary: The join detail view itself, handed on as an object.
details: Going by its name and how the same `.Self` pattern is used on other types, it passes the object to a function that wants it as an argument. The game documents nothing more for this type and no game line uses it.

label: This activity list window
summary: The activity list window itself, handed on as a changeable object.
details: Going by its name, it gives other functions access to the window object. No game line uses it on this type; other types use their own `AccessSelf` to pass the widget on.

label: Close activity list
summary: Closes the activity list window.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button's click in the activity list window. It returns nothing.

label: Activity group items
summary: The list of activity groups shown in the activity list window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list a window area repeats its rows over. The exact content of an item is not stated; the name suggests groups of activities.

label: This activity list window
summary: The activity list window itself, handed on as an object.
details: Going by its name, it passes the window to a function that wants it as an argument. No game line uses it on this type.

label: This locale
summary: The activity locale (a place where an activity happens) itself, handed on as a changeable object.
details: Going by its name, it gives other functions access to the locale object. No game line uses it on this type.

label: Locale description
summary: The description text of an activity locale.
details: Vanilla puts it under the locale's name in the tooltip for entering that locale.

label: Locale icon
summary: The icon picture of an activity locale.
details: Vanilla uses it as the texture of a locale widget. Its return type is not registered, so the game does not say what kind of value it is.

label: Locale name
summary: The name of an activity locale.
details: Vanilla shows it as the text of a locale widget, in a shared tooltip and in the 'Enter ...' tooltip.

label: Locale has icon
summary: Whether the activity locale has an icon.
details: Going by its name and the way other types use their `HasIcon` to show or hide an icon, it is a yes or no check. No game line uses it on this type.

label: This locale
summary: The activity locale itself, handed on as an object.
details: Vanilla passes it into window functions that act on one locale: whether entering it is available, and entering it when clicked.

label: This locale window
summary: The activity locale window itself, handed on as a changeable object.
details: Going by its name, it gives other functions access to the window object. No game line uses it on this type.

label: Special type progress bar
summary: The progress bar of an activity's special type, picked by a name given as the one argument.
details: Its result is a complex bar. Going by the activity window's use of the same name with the key 'activity_special_type_progression', the argument names which bar to take. No game line uses it on this type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Which special type bar, by name.
fields.values: a text key such as 'activity_special_type_progression' (seen on the activity window)

label: Clear selected phase
summary: Clears the phase selected in the locale window, so none is selected any more.
details: Going by its name. Vanilla calls it from clicks in the tournament contest information. It returns nothing.

label: Close locale window
summary: Closes the activity locale window.
details: Vanilla calls it from button clicks in the locale window. It returns nothing.

label: Enter locale tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for entering the given locale.
details: Vanilla gives it the locale itself (`ActivityLocale.Self`) and uses the result as the text of a tooltip.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The locale the tooltip is for.

label: Enter locale
summary: Runs what happens when the player enters the given locale.
details: Vanilla calls it from the click on a locale widget, with the locale itself as the argument. The game does not say what it runs; the name suggests the entering itself. It returns nothing.

label: AI weight for locale
summary: A whole number: the AI's weight for doing the given locale.
details: Vanilla shows it in a locale widget after the text 'AI Weight:'.

label: Activity
summary: The activity the locale window belongs to.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of window parts, so everything inside shows that activity's data.

label: Window background
summary: The background picture of the locale window.
details: Vanilla reads its texture to draw the window background. Its return type is not registered.

label: Character index in guest group
summary: A whole number: the position of a character in a named guest group of the current phase.
details: Going by its name and two arguments, it takes the group name and a character. Vanilla uses the same function name on the activity window, in the imperial examination scoreboard with the group 'entrants' and the player. Not used on this type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a text key such as 'entrants' (seen on the activity window)

label: Characters
summary: The list of characters shown in the locale window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list a window area repeats over, and also counts its entries (a check for at most 3 entries).

label: Guest group of current phase
summary: The list of guests of the current phase that belong to the named group.
details: Vanilla gives it group names such as 'contestant' and 'qualified' in the tournament, and counts or checks the list.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a text key such as 'contestant' or 'qualified'

label: Guest group size label
summary: A short text with the size of a named guest group of the current phase.
details: Going by its name and return type, it makes a text label. Vanilla uses the same name on the activity window with groups 'innovator' and 'conservative' as the text of a label. Not used on this type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a text key such as 'innovator' (seen on the activity window)

label: Event window insert
summary: An object for a part of an event window, built for the widget given.
details: Vanilla calls it with the widget itself (`PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf`) and uses the result as the data context of that widget. The game says nothing more, and its return type is not registered.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The widget the insert is for.
fields.values: a widget, in vanilla the current one

label: Guest sublist
summary: A list of guests picked out by two arguments, used for example to find the winner of a contest.
details: Vanilla passes it a planned phase and the group 'winner', counts its items, and chooses a text by that count in the tournament results line. The meaning of the arguments rests on that use.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The phase the guests belong to.
fields.values: a planned activity phase (as in the vanilla use)

fields.name: Arg1
fields.values: a group name such as 'winner' (as in the vanilla use)

label: Guest group names
summary: The list of guest group names of the locale window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list a window area repeats over in the tournament contest information. Going by its name, each item is the key of a guest group.

label: Intent tooltip
summary: The tooltip text about the host's intent.
details: Going by its name and its text return type. Vanilla uses the same name only on the activity window, as a tooltip. Not used on this type.

label: Last weekly pulse effect
summary: The data of the last effect the activity's weekly pulse (the effect that fires every week) applied.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the locale window. The name suggests the weekly pulse effect, but the game does not say more.

label: Locale background
summary: The background picture of the locale.
details: Going by its name only; no game line uses it.

label: Selected phase
summary: The phase currently selected in the locale window.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context in the tournament contest information, and asks for the underlying phase with `.GetPhase`.

label: Special progress value
summary: The current value of the activity's special progress, as a fixed-point number.
details: Vanilla uses the same name on the activity window in the coronation texts to show the magnificence points reached, for example 'x/25'. Not used with this type itself.

label: Progress bar segment text
summary: The description text of one segment of the special type progress bar.
details: Vanilla uses the same name on the activity window as a tooltip, passing the index of the segment. Not used with this type itself.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a whole number (vanilla computes it from the widget's place in the list)

label: Has active event
summary: Whether an event is currently active in the locale window.
details: Vanilla uses it with `Not` to show parts of the window only while no event is active.

label: Has selected phase
summary: Whether a phase is selected in the locale window.
details: Going by its name and yes or no return type; no game line uses it.

label: Is active progress level
summary: Whether the given special progress level is the one that is active now.
details: Vanilla uses the same name on the activity window to show or hide parts of the progress bar, passing a segment's value. Not used with this type itself.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a value of a bar segment (as in the vanilla use)

label: Is in guest group
summary: Whether a character is in the named guest group of the current phase.
details: Vanilla uses the same name on the activity window with the group 'entrants' and the player, to decide what the imperial examination scoreboard shows. Not used with this type itself.

fields.name: Arg1
fields.values: a character, in vanilla the player

label: Can enter locale
summary: Whether the given locale can be entered now.
details: Vanilla uses it as the 'enabled' condition of a locale widget, with the locale itself as argument, so the widget cannot be clicked when it is false.

label: Open travel planner
summary: Opens the travel planner for the given argument.
details: Going by its name only; no game line uses it and the argument is not described.

label: This locale window
summary: The activity locale window itself, handed on as an object.
details: Going by its name, it passes the window to a function that wants it as an argument. No game line uses it on this type.

label: Sort guest group in all phases
summary: Sets how a named guest group is sorted in all phases.
details: Going by its name and two arguments, probably the group and the sorting key, ascending. Vanilla only uses the descending twin. It returns nothing.

label: Sort all phases descending
summary: Sets a named guest group to be sorted from highest to lowest in all phases, by a named value.
details: Vanilla calls it when the tournament progress widget starts, with the groups 'contestant' and 'qualified' and the value 'progress_to_victory_current'. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a text key such as 'contestant' or 'qualified'

label: Sort guest group
summary: Sets how a named guest group is sorted, ascending.
details: Going by its name and three arguments, probably the phase, the group and the sorting key. No game line uses it. It returns nothing.

label: Sort guest group descending
summary: Sets how a named guest group is sorted, from highest to lowest.
details: Going by its name and three arguments only. No game line uses it. It returns nothing.

label: Select phase
summary: Makes the given phase the selected one in the locale window.
details: Vanilla calls it from clicks, with a planned phase or with the activity's current phase. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a planned phase or the activity's current phase

label: Sort guest group once
summary: Sorts a guest group once by a value, ascending.
details: Going by its name and three arguments only. No game line uses it. It returns nothing.

label: Sort guest group once descending
summary: Sorts a guest group once by a value, from highest to lowest.
details: Going by its name and three arguments only. No game line uses it. It returns nothing.

label: Update guest group
summary: Refreshes the guest groups of the given phase.
details: Vanilla calls it when a tournament contest widget starts and when it is clicked, with the planned phase itself. The name says update; what exactly gets recomputed is not stated. It returns nothing.

label: This log entry
summary: The activity log entry itself, handed on as a changeable object.
details: Going by its name, it gives other functions access to the entry object. No game line uses it on this type.

label: Entry artifact
summary: The artifact an activity log entry is about.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the activity log window, which then shows that artifact. Its return type is not registered.

label: Entry character
summary: The character an activity log entry is about.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context, and checks it with `.IsValid` to see whether the entry has a character at all.

label: Entry date
summary: The date of an activity log entry.
details: Vanilla turns it into text, a full form in the log window and a short form in the tournament contest information.

label: Entry description
summary: The description text of an activity log entry.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the tournament contest information. A separate full description exists (`GetFullDescription`).

label: Entry effect description
summary: The text that describes the effects of an activity log entry.
details: Going by its name and text return type. No game line uses it on this type; buildings use a function of the same name to list their effects.

label: Entry full description
summary: The full description text of an activity log entry.
details: Vanilla shows it as the text in the log window and as a tooltip in the locale window.

label: Entry location
summary: The place an activity log entry happened at.
details: Going by its name only. No game line uses it on this type; other types use a function of the same name to give a place.

label: Entry phase number
summary: A whole number: the number of the activity phase the entry belongs to.
details: Going by its name and return type only. No game line uses it.

label: Entry score
summary: A whole number: the score of an activity log entry.
details: Going by its name and return type only. No game line uses it on this type; other types use a function of the same name to show a score.

label: Entry target
summary: The target an activity log entry refers to.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context in the log window. What kind of object it is depends on the entry, which the game does not say.

label: Entry title
summary: The title text of an activity log entry.
details: Vanilla shows it as the heading text of an entry in the log window, the locale window and the tournament contest information.

label: Entry has no tags
summary: Whether the activity log entry carries no tags at all.
details: Vanilla uses it as a 'visible' condition in the locale window and the tournament contest information, for a plain background of an entry.

label: Entry has tag
summary: Whether the activity log entry carries the given tag.
details: Vanilla checks the tags 'good' and 'bad' to choose how an entry is shown in the locale window.

label: This log entry
summary: The activity log entry itself, handed on as an object.
details: Going by its name, it passes the entry to a function that wants it as an argument. No game line uses it on this type.

label: Show in conclusion
summary: Whether the entry is shown in the conclusion of the activity.
details: Going by its name and yes or no return type only. No game line uses it.

label: This log window
summary: The activity log window itself, handed on as a changeable object.
details: Going by its name, it gives other functions access to the window object. No game line uses it on this type.

label: Close log window
summary: Closes the activity log window.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click in the log window. It returns nothing.

label: Activity
summary: The activity whose log the window shows.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the log window's content.

label: This log window
summary: The activity log window itself, handed on as an object.
details: Going by its name, it passes the window to a function that wants it as an argument. No game line uses it on this type.

label: This option
summary: The activity option itself, handed on as a changeable object.
details: Going by its name, it gives other functions access to the option object. No game line uses it on this type.

label: Option description
summary: The description text of an activity option.
details: Vanilla puts it in the tooltip and description texts of an activity option and of an activity type.

label: Option icon
summary: The icon picture of an activity option.
details: Vanilla uses it as a texture in the activity planner window. Its return type is not registered.

label: Option index in category
summary: A whole number: the place of the option within its category.
details: Vanilla's planner tooltip adds 1 to it before showing 'Level n', so going by that it counts from 0. A comment on the same name for another type says the same.

label: Option validity text
summary: A text that explains whether the option is valid for the character, for example what blocks it.
details: Vanilla gives it the player and the selected special option, and uses the result as a tooltip and as a line in the option's description.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the option is checked for.
fields.values: a character, in vanilla the player

fields.name: Arg1
fields.text: The special option currently selected in the planner.

label: Option name
summary: The name of an activity option.
details: Vanilla shows it as the heading of an option in the planner and in its tooltips.

label: Option texture
summary: The picture of an activity option, as a texture.
details: Vanilla uses it as a texture in the activity planner window. Its return type is not registered.

label: Option is shown
summary: Whether the option is shown to the character at all.
details: Vanilla uses it as the 'visible' condition in the planner, with the player and the selected special option.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character it is shown to.
fields.values: a character, in vanilla the player

fields.name: Arg1
fields.text: The special option currently selected in the planner.

label: Option is valid
summary: Whether the character may pick the option now.
details: Vanilla uses it as the 'enabled' condition of an option in the planner, and its negation to show a blocked look. Arguments are the player and the selected special option.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the option is checked for.
fields.values: a character, in vanilla the player

fields.name: Arg1
fields.text: The special option currently selected in the planner.

label: This option
summary: The activity option itself, handed on as an object.
details: Vanilla uses it to compare the option of a row with the one that is active (`ObjectsEqual`), to show or hide parts of the planner.

label: This option category
summary: The activity option category itself, handed on as a changeable object.
details: Going by its name, it gives other functions access to the category object. No game line uses it on this type.

label: Category name
summary: The name of an activity option category.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the activity planner.

label: Category options
summary: The list of options that belong to the category.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list the planner repeats a row over, one row per option.

label: Category texture
summary: The picture of an activity option category, as a texture.
details: Going by its name only. No game line uses it on this type; other types use `GetTexture` to give a picture.

label: This option category
summary: The activity option category itself, handed on as an object.
details: Going by its name, it passes the category to a function that wants it as an argument. No game line uses it on this type.

label: This phase
summary: The activity phase itself, handed on as a changeable object.
details: Going by its name, it gives other functions access to the phase object. No game line uses it on this type.

label: Can pick phase
summary: Whether the phase can be picked, checked with three arguments.
details: Going by its name and yes or no return type. No game line uses it on this type; the lines that share the name belong to doctrine and tenet items in the rite creation window, so they are only a hint. The three arguments are not described.

label: Phase pick blockers
summary: A text that lists what stops the phase from being picked.
details: Vanilla adds it as a line in the tooltips of phases in the tournament contest planner and the activity planner, and adds a further text when the phase cannot be picked.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a character, in vanilla the player

fields.name: Arg1
fields.values: in vanilla the location of a planned phase

fields.name: Arg2
fields.text: The special option currently selected in the planner.

label: Phase description
summary: The description text of the phase, written for a given activity.
details: Vanilla passes the activity itself (`Activity.Self`) and shows the result in the phase tooltip and in the tournament contest information.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The activity the description is for.

label: Phase icon
summary: The icon picture of an activity phase.
details: Vanilla uses it as a texture in the activity window and the planner. Its return type is not registered.

label: Phase illustration
summary: The large illustration picture of an activity phase.
details: Going by its name only. No game line uses it on this type; lines with the same name belong to other types.

label: Phase small illustration
summary: The small illustration picture of an activity phase.
details: Vanilla uses it as a texture in the tournament contest selection.

label: Phase key
summary: The script key of the phase, as text.
details: Going by its name and text return type. No game line uses it on this type; other types use `GetKey` for debug text and to build names.

label: Phase name
summary: The name of an activity phase.
details: Vanilla uses it as the heading of tooltips of phases in the tournament contest planner.

label: Phase short description
summary: A shorter description text of the phase.
details: Vanilla uses it in the tooltips of phases in the activity planner and the contest planner. The game does not say how it differs from `GetDescription` beyond the name.

label: Phase is predefined
summary: Going by its name, whether an activity phase is a predefined one.
details: Its one use is in a debug window that watches the AI: a predefined phase is shown as "-predefined-" instead of its score. The game documents nothing more.

label: Phase is shown
summary: Whether the phase is shown to the character at all.
details: Vanilla uses it as the 'visible' condition in the tournament contest selection, with the player and the selected special option.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character it is shown to.
fields.values: a character, in vanilla the player

fields.name: Arg1
fields.text: The special option currently selected in the planner.

label: This phase
summary: The activity phase itself, handed on as an object.
details: Vanilla passes it into planner functions, for example to select the phase type when a row is clicked.

label: Planner as travel planner
summary: The planner viewed as a travel planner.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context in the activity planner window. Its return type is not registered.

label: Cost breakdown
summary: The cost breakdown of the activity being planned.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context of parts of the planner that show the costs. The breakdown's contents are not described here.

label: Phase being edited
summary: The phase that is currently being edited, as a changeable object.
details: Vanilla passes it to `RemovePhase` in the tournament contest selection.

label: Planner options
summary: The list of activity options the planner offers.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list the planner window repeats over.

label: Phase page data
summary: The paging data of the phase list (how many items are shown).
details: Vanilla sets how many items are shown (`SetShownItems`), resets it, and uses it as a data context in the tournament contest selection.

label: Planned phases
summary: The list of phases planned so far.
details: Vanilla counts its entries to show the number of stops in a travel plan.

label: Phases the player picked
summary: The list of phases the player has picked.
details: Vanilla uses it as a list in the tournament contest selection, and counts it to decide what to show.

label: This planner
summary: The activity planner itself, handed on as a changeable object.
details: Vanilla passes it to the functions that open or toggle other game views, such as the activity guest list and the intent selection.

label: Single location phase
summary: The phase of a single-location plan, as a changeable object.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context in the tournament contest selection.

label: Special guests
summary: The list of special guests of the planned activity.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list the planner repeats over and checks whether it has items, to show that area only when there are some.

label: Option cost total
summary: The total cost breakdown of the chosen activity options.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context in the planner window. The breakdown's contents are not described here.

label: Phase cost total
summary: The total cost breakdown of the planned phases.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context in the planner window and the tournament contest selection.

label: Add guest to group
summary: Adds a guest to a named guest group of a phase being planned.
details: Vanilla calls it with the planned phase, the player, and the group 'contestant' or 'spectator', when the tournament contest selection starts and when a button is clicked. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The phase the group belongs to.

fields.name: Arg1
fields.values: a character, in vanilla the player

fields.name: Arg2
fields.text: The group to add them to.

label: Set creation object
summary: Stores an object under a name, to be given to the activity when it is created.
details: Vanilla calls it in the funeral planner with the name 'body_to_bury' and a character, when a deceased person is chosen. It returns nothing. Setting the same name again replaces the earlier object, going by the name 'AddOrSet'.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name the object is stored under.

fields.name: Arg1
fields.values: in vanilla a character as a script scope

label: Add phase
summary: Adds a phase to the plan.
details: Vanilla calls it from a click in the tournament contest selection. Its argument there is the text 'phase'. It returns nothing.

label: Can add more phases
summary: Whether another phase can be added to the plan.
details: Going by its name and yes or no return type only. No game line uses it.

label: Can plan more phases
summary: Whether more phases of the given type can be planned.
details: Vanilla uses it inside the phase tooltips of the contest planner, next to the text of what blocks a phase. The argument is a phase type.

label: Can go to next planning stage
summary: Whether the planning can move on to the next stage.
details: Vanilla uses it as the 'enabled' condition of the planner's continue buttons. The matching text for a blocked button is `GetCanProgressPlanningStageTooltip`.

label: Can select doctrine slot
summary: Whether the doctrine slot with the given number can be selected.
details: Vanilla uses it with slot numbers 0, 1 and 2 to show or hide the slots in the planner.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a whole number such as 0, 1 or 2

label: Can select tenet slot
summary: Whether the tenet slot with the given number can be selected.
details: Vanilla uses it with slot numbers 0, 1 and 2 to show or hide the slots in the planner.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a whole number such as 0, 1 or 2

label: Cancel phase editing
summary: Stops editing the current phase without keeping the change.
details: Vanilla calls it from a click in the tournament contest selection. It returns nothing.

label: Clear doctrine slot
summary: Empties the doctrine slot with the given number.
details: Vanilla calls it from clicks with slot numbers 0, 1 and 2. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a whole number such as 0, 1 or 2

label: Clear creation object
summary: Removes the object stored under the given name for the activity's creation.
details: Vanilla calls it on a right click in the funeral planner with the name 'body_to_bury', which undoes the choice of the deceased. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name the object was stored under.

label: Clear tenet slot
summary: Empties the tenet slot with the given number.
details: Vanilla calls it from clicks with slot numbers 0, 1 and 2. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a whole number such as 0, 1 or 2

label: Close planner
summary: Closes the activity planner.
details: Vanilla calls it from button clicks in the planner window and in the tournament contest selection. It returns nothing.

label: Confirm multi-destination
summary: Confirms the choice of several destinations in a travel plan.
details: Vanilla calls it from a click in the planner window. The name says finalize; what else it sets off is not stated. It returns nothing.

label: Active phase start date
summary: The date the active phase starts.
details: Going by its name only. No game line uses it, and its return type is not registered.

label: Option cost
summary: A text with the cost of the given activity option.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the planner, with the option itself as the argument.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The option whose cost is shown.

label: Activity type
summary: The type of activity being planned.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of parts of the planner window.

label: Planner as travel planner
summary: The planner viewed as a travel planner, for reading.
details: Vanilla chains it to the travel plan data, to show the expected arrival date at the final destination in a travel summary text. `AccessAsTravelPlanner` is the changeable form.

label: Next stage tooltip
summary: The tooltip text that explains whether the planning can move to the next stage.
details: Vanilla uses it as the tooltip of the planner's continue buttons, next to `CanProgressPlanningStage`.

label: Phase cost
summary: A text with the cost of the given planned phase.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the planner, with the planned phase itself as the argument.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The phase whose cost is shown.

label: Doctrine debate tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for the doctrine slot with the given number.
details: Vanilla uses it with slot numbers 0, 1 and 2 as the tooltips of the doctrine slots in the planner.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a whole number such as 0, 1 or 2

label: Option being edited
summary: The activity option that is currently being edited.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context in the planner window.

label: Phase being edited
summary: The phase that is currently being edited, for reading.
details: Vanilla passes it to `IsFirstPickedPhase` to decide what the tournament contest selection shows. `AccessEditingPhase` is the changeable form.

label: Guest start delay
summary: A whole number: the delay for guests to start, in days.
details: Going by its name only; the unit 'days' is in the name. No game line uses it.

label: Number of invited characters
summary: A whole number: how many characters are invited to the activity.
details: Vanilla shows it in the guest buttons' text, as 'Other Guests (n)' and 'Manage Guests (n)'.

label: Number of pickable phases
summary: A whole number: how many phases may be picked at most.
details: Vanilla shows it as the upper number in the travel planner's 'Selected stops: x/y'.

label: Number of picked phases
summary: A whole number: how many phases are picked so far.
details: Vanilla shows it as the first number in the travel planner's 'Selected stops: x/y'.

label: Creation object
summary: The object stored under the given name for the activity's creation.
details: Going by its name and its single argument; it is the reading counterpart of `AddOrSetOnCreationObject`. No game line uses it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name the object was stored under.
fields.values: a text such as 'body_to_bury' (used when storing)

label: Selected doctrine
summary: The doctrine chosen in the slot with the given number.
details: Vanilla uses it with slot numbers 0, 1 and 2 as the data context of the doctrine slots in the planner.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a whole number such as 0, 1 or 2

label: Selected host intent
summary: The intent the host has chosen for the activity.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context in the planner window.

label: Selected special option
summary: The special option chosen in the planner.
details: Vanilla passes it as the second argument of the option and phase checks (valid, shown) and of tooltip functions.

label: Selected tenet
summary: The tenet chosen in the slot with the given number.
details: Vanilla uses it with slot numbers 0, 1 and 2 as the data context of the tenet slots in the planner.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a whole number such as 0, 1 or 2

label: Single location phase
summary: The phase of a single-location plan, for reading.
details: Vanilla uses it in the contest tooltips and in the texts of the gruesome festival options. `AccessSingleLocationPhase` is the changeable form.

label: Special guest invite effects
summary: A text that describes the effects of inviting the given special guest.
details: Vanilla uses it in the tooltip of a special guest slot in the planner, after the guest type's name and description.

label: Tenet debate tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for the tenet slot with the given number.
details: Vanilla uses it with slot numbers 0, 1 and 2 as the tooltips of the tenet slots in the planner.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a whole number such as 0, 1 or 2

label: Tenet sort controller
summary: The object that controls how the tenet list is sorted.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the tenet and doctrine selection part of the planner. Its return type is not registered.

label: Total travel days
summary: A whole number: the estimated number of travel days in total.
details: Going by its name and return type only. No game line uses it.

label: Travel days for phase
summary: A whole number: the travel days needed for the given planned phase.
details: Vanilla shows it as 'n days' in the travel planner, with the planned phase itself as the argument.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The phase the travel time is for.

label: Has picked a phase
summary: Whether at least one phase has been picked.
details: Vanilla uses it as a 'visible' condition in the planner and the tournament contest selection.

label: Has planned a phase
summary: Whether at least one phase has been planned.
details: Going by its name and yes or no return type only. No game line uses it.

label: Has special option
summary: Whether a special option has been selected in the planner.
details: Going by its name and yes or no return type only. No game line uses it.
